thread:
maria_fin: Quick heads-up — we're planning a phased price adjustment for the high-usage SKU (A/B experiment + opt-in grandfathering). Need an ops + billing sanity check before we publish the pricing sheet. CSV of affected cohort attached in Google Drive: https://drive.company/reports/pricing-cohort-2026Q1.csv :eyes:

sam_ops: I can look. Main concerns from ops side: throttling thresholds, dedicated capacity flags, and whether we should auto-fallback to older rate if metering detects billing anomalies.

ben_product: For the A/B split we want 10% control / 90% treatment for new signups and 100% grandfather for existing paid customers older than 90 days. Is that what the CSV shows?

maria_fin: Yes — CSV has cohort_tag, customer_id, signup_date, current_rate. Snippet:
```
cohort_tag,customer_id,signup_date,current_rate
control,acct_123,2024-06-12,0.12
treatment,acct_456,2025-01-05,0.15
grandfather,acct_789,2023-11-01,0.10
```

jess_engineering: Two quick technical checks: 1) billing pipeline supports per-customer rate overrides today, but backfill credits need a one-off job. 2) meter export truncates at midnight UTC — we should be explicit about cutover timestamps.

maria_fin: Good to know. For backfill we were thinking: if we change the rate retroactively for the grandfather cohort, issue prorated credit for the current billing period only. Nothing pre-period. That reduces accounting churn. Thoughts?

olivia_sales: Sales asks that we allow manual exceptions for strategic accounts (sales@ can request). Need SLA on turnaround (24-48h). Also, flag in console so reps can see who is grandfathered.

sam_ops: Manual exceptions ok, but we need workflow: ticket in zendesk + billing-change audit log. Engineering: can we add a metadata flag so Console shows "grandfathered: yes"?

jess_engineering: Yep — we can add a boolean field in the customer metadata. Small schema change, deployable in a minor release. ETA: 3 business days for Console patch, 1 day to wire up audit event.

ben_product: Another gating point: throttling delta. If treatment increases per-token cost/throughput we might route heavy customers to Dedicated. Ops, please add a route plan.

sam_ops: On it. I'll draft routing policy. Also need to confirm whether Reserved customers are excluded from A/B. They typically are; confirm with finance.

maria_fin: Reserved customers are excluded from pricing experiment — they keep contract terms. Marked in CSV as reserved=true.

nathan_billingbot: Automated check: historical invoice snapshots exist for 94% of cohort. Missing snapshots: acct_432, acct_998. Please verify archival retention.

maria_fin: Thanks @nathan_billingbot — Jess, can the backfill job skip customers without snapshots and flag them for manual review?

jess_engineering: Yes. We'll emit a report of skipped accounts and a suggested credit amount column set to "MANUAL_REVIEW".

olivia_sales: Also, for messaging: we need an email template for grandfathered customers explaining no change, and a separate note for the A/B treatment that explains the benefits and cost change. Marketing to approve.

ben_product: Approvals needed: finance sign-off on credit policy, legal on TOS language, product + eng on implementation plan. If we get all that by Friday, we can start a staged publish next Tuesday.

maria_fin: I'll drive finance + legal sign-off. Quick checklist I'm tracking:
- confirm cohort CSV (done)
- reserve/exclude list checked (done)
- backfill credit policy (proposed: prorated current period only)
- manual exception workflow (ticket + audit)
- console metadata patch (ENG)
- notification templates (Marketing/Sales)
- final publish window (Tues 15:00 UTC)

sam_ops: Looks good. I'll add routing policy and capacity gating doc in #eng-infra by EOD.

jess_engineering: I'll schedule the backfill job and console patch. Need 2 reviewers for the deploy — @ben_product and @sam_ops please.

olivia_sales: :thumbsup: From sales side we'll prep the exception requests spreadsheet and a short FAQ for reps.

maria_fin: One last thing — meter edge case: customers using multiple orgs often get split usage. Please ensure credit calculation is per-billing-entity, not per-org id. Jess: can you confirm?

jess_engineering: Confirmed. Credits will be computed per billing_entity_id.

ben_product: If no objections, I'm ok with the plan. Approving the staged publish contingent on legal + finance final signoffs.

maria_fin: Great — tagging for approvals. @legal-team @finance-approvals please review. Will post the final publish note here once signed off. :sparkles:

nathan_billingbot: Reminder: staging billing run scheduled at 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z. Run will simulate credits against sample cohort.

maria_fin: Thanks everyone — followups in thread.

sam_ops: Thanks — will sync with infra team :rocket:
